timestampConvention: EAT wall-clock (UTC+03:00), no offset in CSV

source.coverageWarning: Observed timestamps reach the registered archive window 2020-01-24 through 2026-10-01; missing dates and intraday gaps remain recorded and were not filled.
source.metadataAtrMethod: Simple rolling mean of true range over the trailing 14 reliable candles; unreliable rows carry forward the last reliable ATR.

sample.atrMethod: Wilder ATR(14), first value = SMA of first 14 true ranges

unscheduledShocks.definition: absolute close-to-close return > 4 prior Wilder ATR

calendar.note: The primary week template is the most frequent exact Monday-Friday slot pattern; up to five recurring templates are summarized separately. Repeated non-weekend gaps of 60-240 minutes are classified as scheduled session breaks only when the exact EAT weekday/time pair and duration occur at least 40 times. All source bars and timestamps remain unchanged; other gaps are unclassified closures, not verified holidays or feed outages.
